title: Preserve search readability when applying planning successors
outcome: Successor revisions and blockers preserve the supported search-readability contract, or have an explicitly documented and behavior-tested exemption.
acceptance: Oversized incoming successor revisions and blocker details either refuse with a supported typed result before mutation or remain readable by search under a documented supported contract.
Behavioral coverage exercises both oversized paths and ordinary valid successors without bypassing native admission semantics.
